note.note:
Please provide the following so I can generate the exact structured note:

- Transcript: the full doctor–patient conversation (raw text).
- Differential Diagnosis (JSON): the DDx as returned by your diagnostic reasoning model.

Notes:
- I will extract only clinically relevant information (presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, allergies, medications, relevant exam findings, clinical impression/working diagnoses, management plan, follow-up).
- I will reference the DDx only if consistent with the transcript, and I will label each differential with a likelihood (High/Moderate/Low) and a one-line justification.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- If there is any conflict between the transcript and the DDx, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”
- Output will follow the exact structure and headings you specified.
